title: Test CapturedStderrProcess bounds only the child's exit, not the stderr drain: a grandchild holding the inherited pipe hangs the test forever
outcome: Test CapturedStderrProcess bounds only the child's exit, not the stderr drain: a grandchild holding the inherited pipe hangs the test forever
acceptance: CapturedStderrProcess::wait_with_limit (src/tests/phase_sync.rs) bounds the whole teardown, the stderr reader's drain included, by the deadlock guard: when the direct child has exited but a descendant still holds the stderr write handle, the call returns an error naming the phase and 'stderr drain did not reach EOF' within the guard, instead of blocking in reader.join().

A test that spawns a child which starts a descendant inheriting stderr and then exits, reproducing the hang on the unchanged code (fail-first recorded), passes after the fix, with no process killed by hand and no larger timeout.
